items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: I heard this other fella die in two stormy weather.

ctx.x: Well, I don't see him anymore. I heard this other fella die in two stormy weather. Yeah, he died. He died, huh?
You remember the Nancy Hanks? The what? Nancy Hanks Saloon. That was on Everville though. That was on the other side of the canal.
